nodes.label: Canonical Room/Variant/Component Format
nodes.rationale: A room is keyed by name, type and secrets; variants hold cell components with core and stable hashes plus seen, updatedAt and source labels for auditing. Variants must be contiguous and at most four cells, larger or disconnected shapes are treated as corrupted data.

nodes.label: RARE Room Type
nodes.rationale: RARE is a separate blue map type with ordinary room, door and clear mechanics; eight unambiguous Rare names promote legacy NORMAL or UNKNOWN records on load, and normal and rare rooms keep separate owners and clear credit even when adjacent.

nodes.label: Lava Pit Duplicate Entries
nodes.rationale: The established NORMAL Lava Pit and the user-identified RARE Lava Pit are two distinct entries sharing only a name; the shared name implies no shared geometry or metadata, and the Rare entry reuses already observed hashes with intentional 0/0 placeholders rather than generated wiki values.

nodes.label: Prince Metadata and Overrides
nodes.rationale: Prince is never inferred from crypt counts; false means no source-backed marker rather than confirmed absence. Explicit /kung room prince corrections are keyed by normalized name, type and secret count, work with Local Data off and take precedence after metadata normalization.

nodes.label: Room Data Project Link
nodes.rationale: A linked checkout becomes authoritative even with Local Data off, routing room JSON, type hints and preload observations straight into the module resources with atomic replacement. It is deliberately not seeded from stale JAR, profile or remote data so linking cannot import earlier profile learning.

nodes.label: Local Data Toggle
nodes.rationale: Local profile room data is an opt-in override layer so stale files in a Modrinth profile cannot silently change normal player matching. The toggle controls recognition only, not whether a write may erase earlier saved observations, which is why learning reads existing local JSON regardless.

nodes.label: Unique Partial Room Completion
nodes.rationale: Two direct matching cells can reveal every remaining cell of a uniquely placed room. Predictions are cached separately and used only by the render layout; they never become scan evidence, learning records, logical owners, score credit or synchronized data.

nodes.label: Visibility Gating of Preload Aliases
nodes.rationale: The first implementation disabled room connections as soon as one cell became visible, breaking obvious partial shapes. Visibility now gates only bundled and session preload identity aliases, while direct catalog hashes keep priority and a direct known observation survives later unknown block states.

nodes.label: Owner Merge Four-Cell Guard
nodes.rationale: Identity-based merging ignored ordinary map-door boundaries and neither owner-union pass checked the combined cell count, so two Bridges matches became one five-cell owner with propagated completion. A union above four cells is now rejected and narrow external map doors are respected.

nodes.label: Map Trap Palette Byte Recognition
nodes.rationale: Generic Trap is recognized from a majority of exact palette byte 62 in the bounded room interior, independently confirmed against Skyblocker DungeonMapUtils where 62 is TRAP and 63 a normal room. This establishes map interpretation only, not Old/New identity, catalog metadata or a secret count.

nodes.label: Homeserver Room Sync
nodes.rationale: Two separate paths share one homeserver: memory-only live run snapshots that expire and are never written into learned files, and an older shared learned room-data cache. Sync toggles are session-only so a restart cannot leave them silently enabled, and the server only merges reports, never deletes.
